title: Man shot dead at Bukidnon wake after fistfight

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A drinking spree at a wake in Baungon, Bukidnon ended in tragedy early Monday when a 34-year-old man was fatally shot in the head by his drinking companion following a fistfight. The Baungon Municipal Police Station (MPS) reported that the incident occurred in Purok 6, Barangay Langaon around 6 a.m.
